name: studio-remotion-renderer
title: Studio Render Backend — Switch to Remotion (React + Headless Chromium)
summary: Replace the broken hyperframes/Node-bridge studio render path with a Remotion-based pipeline: React compositions rendered server-side via @remotion/bundler + @remotion/renderer. Fixes /api/studio/projects/{id}/render 500s caused by hyperframes npm package being absent, and unlocks the OpenRouter integration roadmap (image/video backgrounds per scene).
